method: 60 overlapping subsamples of 134 stores drawn without replacement from 168 training stores. Each independently retunes minimum-mean-RMSE Lasso over the original 121 penalties with five-fold CV. Scaling occurs inside every fold. Final coefficients are refitted on that subsample.
limits: Training-only subsampling sensitivity, not independent new datasets, validation, a formal stability-selection method, causal inference, or confidence probabilities. Changes combine subsample and CV fold variability. All reserved test rows unused.
